title: Competition Overview
description: CaseVerse brings together university students from across Bangladesh to tackle real-world business challenges through the lens of sustainability. Teams of 3–4 undergraduate students compete across three rounds, developing strategic solutions aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
eligibility: Open to all undergraduate students enrolled in recognized universities across Bangladesh
Teams must consist of 3–4 members from the same university
Each team must have a designated team leader
Members must provide valid student identification
format: Three-round elimination competition with case analysis, video content creation, and a live grand finale.
venue: Jatiya Kabi Kazi Nazrul Islam University, Trishal, Mymensingh

philosophy.title: Business + Sustainability + Real-World Impact
philosophy.description: Every solution must balance business viability with environmental and social responsibility.

prizes.title: Certificates
prizes.description: All participants will receive certificates of participation.

prizes.title: Special Recognition
prizes.description: Outstanding individual contributions may receive special recognition.
